public_source_policy: The public bundle ships only the training-identity mean neutral ROI (feature_template_vertices, a population statistic). No individual FaceScape scan is redistributed in the public build. Real-identity sources are served exclusively by the local research service on machines with licensed data access.
display_convention: Editor display is edit-relative (display convention v4). Displayed anchor = taper * (R(c) - R(0)): the PURE learned Ridge field at native amplitude, multiplied by the ROI boundary taper (smoothstep of the graph geodesic distance to the ROI boundary; the band is 5 units near the landmarks and widens smoothly to 12 units in rim regions far from every landmark, so the lateral cheek-side band next to the alae tapers gently; every landmark sits at weight >= 0.93) so the ROI rim never follows an edit, then 12 rounds of rim-pinned Laplacian smoothing (lambda 0.5, boundary ring re-clamped to zero every round) that diffuse the strain the taper concentrates inside its band into a smooth boundary layer -- no wrinkle ring at the ROI boundary. Displayed certified = smooth_pinned(taper * (anchor + smooth(resid(c) - resid(0)))): the RB-SR correction is shown as the EDIT-RELATIVE projected residual -- the residual at the requested controls minus the residual at zero controls (removing the CVAE's edit-independent bias field, which would otherwise appear as a static bump pattern) -- with the nine landmark-pinned values filled by their one-ring neighbour mean and 20 rounds of Laplacian smoothing (lambda 0.5) removing high-frequency proposal noise. At zero controls both displays are exactly zero. RB-SR corrects the Ridge anchor precisely where the linear operator under-realises the requested edit (roughly 1/3 handle reach vs 60-95% certified). No handle enforcement or control amplification exists in the display frame. The certified-pipeline internals (gate, projection, fold-subset certificate) keep the hard point-wise handle contract and are evaluated on the raw frozen-pipeline meshes exactly as in the paper.

sliders.note: controls = sliders @ matrix; identical in browser and Python runtimes. Rows are sparse role-restricted semantic directions (tip rotation -> tip along the rotation arc about the alar-base pivot; tip projection -> tip z; dorsum height -> dorsum + radix y; alar width -> alar-base x; tip width -> tip-lobule lateral pair x), so each slider moves exactly its anatomical target. Roles are derived from the frozen five-subunit vertex partition (landmark_subunits). The displayed deformation is the PURE learned Ridge field at native amplitude (no display-frame handle enforcement, no control amplification), multiplied by the ROI boundary taper stored in ridge_browser.json and rim-pinned Laplacian smoothed (see display_taper.edge_smooth_*). The bridgeSmoothing row stored here is the mean-source instance of a SOURCE-ADAPTIVE hump-removal row (slider=+1 flattens the dorsal-profile deviation of the bound source); both runtimes recompute it at source-bind time with the same formula.

ood.provenance: raw 27-D landmark controls of all 4830 frozen validation pairs

policy.rule: chi = ||c / per_dim_std||_2; chi <= within: evaluated range; within < chi <= near: near boundary (request is scaled back to the within-threshold); chi > near: outside evaluated range, preview withheld
policy.semantics: Input-applicability control on the requested edit. This is NOT the residual certificate and is never described as safety or confidence.

zero_edit_baseline.note: R(0) magnitude on the mean source; removed by the edit-relative display frame

accepted_meshes.requirement: PLY registered to the frozen FaceScape TU correspondence; full heads have their ROI extracted via the frozen index map

head_context.source: mean of 6 registered FaceScape training-split neutral heads (TU topology, vertex-wise correspondence)
head_context.policy: Population statistic for display context only; no individual FaceScape scan is redistributed.
